reason: A desktop integration plugin that wraps the live DeepSeek Harness web interface in an Electron native window and provides installation, launch, profile registration, shortcut creation, and lifecycle management.

summaries.zh: 将实时 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面封装在 Electron 原生桌面窗口中，并提供安装注册、快捷方式创建和启动管理。
summaries.en: Wraps the live DeepSeek Harness web interface in an Electron desktop window with plugin registration, shortcut creation, installation, and launch management.

capabilities: Loads the local DeepSeek Harness web UI over localhost
Registers and unregisters the plugin in a DeepSeek Harness profile
Starts and stops the local backend
Opens external links in the system browser
